description: How many clips a heistclips account has left (free clips remaining and paid clips remaining) and what more clips cost: the free clips a new account starts with, and the clip packs with their prices. Answers 'how many clips do I have left', 'what does a clip cost', 'I ran out of credits', 'no credits'. Takes the account code from cut_clip when there is one. With no code, the free allowance a new account starts with and the pack prices, not someone's balance. Finding moments is free. One cut costs one clip.
